verdict.rationale: HMRC's online services and app could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data. 'Ask HMRC online' is not shown to be AI-driven, and the other items cover registration, account management and Making Tax Digital software channels.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
